# Suvan Fora

> Suvan Fora is an independent luxury travel advisory serving high-net-worth (HNI) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNI) clients. It designs and books bespoke vacations — private villas, five-star resorts, private islands, safaris, and yacht/private jet coordination — through the Fora Travel network, at the same price as booking direct, plus complimentary VIP perks (room upgrades, resort credit, priority check-in/checkout).

## Who this is for
High-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth individuals and families seeking a dedicated, discreet travel advisor for fully personalized luxury vacations, rather than self-booking through OTAs.

## What Suvan Fora offers
- Bespoke luxury vacation planning and itinerary design
- Private villa and estate rentals with on-the-ground staff
- Five-star resort and suite bookings with VIP amenities
- Overwater and private-island escapes (Maldives, Bora Bora, Seychelles)
- Luxury safari and expedition travel
- Yacht and private jet trip coordination
- Destination weddings, honeymoons, and milestone trips
- Multi-generational family travel planning

## How booking works
Clients submit a trip request (destination, dates, preferences) via the form on https://suvanfora.com/, or message @suvan.fora on Instagram. Suvan Fora then designs a custom itinerary and sends a personalized Fora Travel booking link for that specific trip (the booking link varies by client and destination, since it routes through Fora's advisor-matching system). Fora Travel has facilitated more than $2 billion in bookings across 180+ countries. Booking through an advisor costs the same as booking direct and adds complimentary perks not available to the general public.

## Key facts
- Powered by / affiliated with Fora Travel (foratravel.com)
- Serves clients worldwide; no destination is off-limits
- Advisory service is free to the client; revenue comes from hotel/resort partner commissions
- Instagram: @suvan.fora
